outlook.statement: due to geopolitical tensions, disrupted energy supplies, global trade flows and inflationary pressure, the economic and financial activities could get impacted. Consequently, the Company's profitability might get affected in the coming periods.

with the diversification of Company's business coupled with favorable Government's initiatives to boost the economic and financial activities of the country, the Company expects better financial performance in the coming periods.

During the FY 2025-26, the Indian financial markets remained highly volatile due to rising trade tensions, heightened geopolitical uncertainties and foreign investor exits. Nevertheless, your Company performed reasonably during the year. Also, management's balanced approach towards portfolio management, diversification and its continuous review and timely actions has enabled it to make appropriate investment decisions from time to time.

India's medium-to-long-term trajectory continues to be shaped by its stated ambition of becoming a fully developed, high-income economy by 2047. The Company's outlook is anchored in continuity rather than dramatic change - a predominantly investment-led portfolio, calibrated across financial, commodities and real estate market instruments as opportunities and risks evolve.
The International Monetary Fund projected Indian growth at 6.4% for FY 2026-27, while continuing to rank India as one of the fastest-growing major economies.
